constraints: Only applies to legacy Web sessions (databases converted from versions prior to 4D v18 R6); returns null date/time values when scalable web sessions mode is enabled.
Each new Web request resets the cookie's expiration to request-time + the 'Web inactive session timeout' setting, so the returned expDate/expTime reflect the most recent request, not a fixed value.

overloadMerges.note: Autoparse defaulted all three parameters to direction 'in', but the parameterTable arrows show expDate and expTime are filled in by the command (out), not supplied by the caller.

params.name: expDate
params.description: Filled with the date of cookie expiration

params.name: expTime
params.description: Filled with the time of cookie expiration

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns, in expDate and expTime, the expiration date and time of the session cookie for the legacy Web session identified by sessionID.
